scope: Actual native planner/transport cost and recommendation quality on a supplied finite cost-matrix/path profile. Matrix arithmetic is not real-application performance or execution authority.
source_separation: Original private native NDU source and identity remain unchanged. Controls are a separately built Rust crate with explicit distinct algorithm/source identity, same serde_json version, bounded stream framing and complete response shape.
information: For each decision construct one canonical validated graph and complete original request bytes. All three arms receive byte-identical request/candidates/event costs/verification labels/budgets; no arm-specific runtime observation updates. Common construction/admission/evidence costs charged once to each standalone arm.
exact_control: Exact Q32 linear suffix dynamic programming over each supplied complete candidate event path, retaining complete value tables and all root-value ties. A hash-map or cloned suffix key is unnecessary work for this flat profile; no cross-request state is retained.
light_control: Native myopic control sees the same complete request and feasibility data, but ranks by the first batch's two event costs; report actual full-path utility and regret separately.
formal_materialization: No formal input packets are generated or evaluated before remote preregistration.
cache_policy: Zero cross-request decision or result caches in every arm. DP memoization is only within one request. OS/cache/provider state is not reset or claimed controlled.
order: Rotate the three-arm order by decision index; all arms start a new bounded session at the same 256-decision boundary.
cold_policy: Measure current exact-source empty-target build, process launch/handshake and cleanup separately. Charge each standalone arm its applicable actual build/startup plus common costs. Reusing preinstalled toolchain/dependency cache is explicit; unknown acquisition/human cost is not zero.
amortization: Only measured prefix horizons 1/32/256/2048; no unlimited lifetime extrapolation. Session renewal and final cleanup costs retained and charged.
quality: Python exhaustive tiny-development oracle must agree with native exact-DP and original NDU on full values, rejected candidates, winning frontier and abstention. Formal inputs compare exact-DP/NDU frontier and host-admitted full-path utilities; myopic regret is a descriptive finite-matrix quantity.
no_rerun: Keep every started request and failure; close and stop on ambiguity, timeout, drift or mismatched semantics. No exclusion, budget relaxation or formal seed replacement.
native_process_scope: Unmodified NDU emits original recursive evidence. Controls emit distinct scalar recurrence receipts with the same response shape. These evidence algorithms differ. Measure native transport/parse/envelope wall separately from host structural/quality checks; no unavailable pure-compute time or equal-evidence-cost claim.
prefix_cleanup_accounting: For a measured prefix include the actual close cost of every touched session. If prefix ends before request256, this close was observed at the declared boundary later in the same study, not a separate stop-at-prefix experiment. Label prefix numbers accounting totals, not independently executed horizon trials.
evidence_accounting: Retain every original canonical request and every actual native response frame as original byte strings/hex in one channel-labelled interleaved lossless XZ archive, with a flushed pending journal before each native call. One independent XZ member per decision. Decode every member and recheck original byte lengths, SHA256, request linkage, sequence and denominator. All measured shared archive writing/compression/finalization/audit costs are common assay overhead charged equally once to each standalone arm, never attributed to native algorithm speed. Detailed per-decision accounting rows are retained inside the same archive, with post-write/compression times in the member index; RESULT.json contains the audited summary and prefix ledgers instead of duplicating all rows.
ambiguity: Protocol/identity ambiguity stops the study. A declared multiple-candidate frontier with null recommendation is a defined abstaining result, retained with regret range and no fabricated tie-break.
formal_registration: Runner must verify the exact FREEZE blob exists at the operator-supplied published registration commit, all bound source blobs match the code commit, and the one-shot execution claim is absent. Root independently verifies remote publication before authorization.
unmeasured_costs: Python interpreter bootstrap before instrumented entry
